name: Shimazu-sensei
source:
The homeroom teacher of Yuuta's underclassmen.
As she is still inexperienced and weak-willed, her pupils are always making fun of her.
Maybe she would do lessons naked if someone ordered her to?

[From in-game charater profile]

She teaches class 201.
